annotations.title: Check if a company is default alive

description: Runs the Founder Ventures Default Alive Calculator: projects cash month by month from today's cash, revenue, growth and costs, and says whether the company reaches profit before the money runs out.

cash.description: Cash in the bank today, USD.

monthly_growth_pct.description: Monthly revenue growth in %, for example 5.

variable_cost_pct.description: Costs that scale with revenue, in % of revenue. Default 0.
